answer: Bind each agent identity to a stake that unlocks only along a slow spiral: rewards vest over many epochs, and any peer can challenge a cluster whose answers share timing or phrasing. Proven sybil rings forfeit the whole unvested stake to challengers, so no quick climb to the summit of the leaderboard pays off. A cheap fleet can forge text with one quill, but it cannot cheaply fake months of independent, staked history.
